Expansion extends support to MUSC Health’s retail and specialty pharmacy operations

Santa Clara, Calif. — July 29, 2026 – SoundHound AI Inc. (Nasdaq: SOUN), a global leader in voice and agentic AI, today announced the expansion of “Emily,” MUSC Health’s AI agent built on SoundHound’s next-generation agentic AI platform. The expansion extends support to MUSC Health’s retail and specialty pharmacy operations and builds on a successful collaboration that has supported more than 2.2 million patient calls across the health system.

# Mercy nurses cut documentation time 22% with Microsoft AI

Published: 2026-08-14T14:34:59+00:00
Source: beckershospitalreview.com (beckershospitalreview.com)
Language: en

## Story

Chesterfield, Mo.-based Mercy reported a 22% reduction in flowsheet documentation time per shift after rolling out Microsoft’s Dragon Copilot AI assistant to nurses, according to a Microsoft customer story published Aug. 14.

Mercy piloted the ambient AI tool in a single innovation unit starting in August 2025 before expanding to additional units, including all medical-surgical units systemwide. The health system operates more than 50 hospitals and nearly 1,000 care sites across Arkansas, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri and Oklahoma, employing about 15,000 nurses.
